parent: round 5 reference KM on k=28..43, and round 3 partial verdict. KM_gl is void. KM_pack is not used.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
circuit: original shared-gamma KM only. One gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell controls per layer. Interleaved packing. FK = J@J with zero diagonal. FM = block means on the interleaved triples. Parameter count 3+3L. QAOA is independent gamma_l and beta_l, mixer sum X, 2L, same budget as round 4.
idea: Round 3 found that independent repeats of the standard KM search agree at N=9 and N=12, so adding more of the same starts is not the gap. This round adds four initial points that the standard search does not build. Three sit on the shared-gamma projection of the equal-depth QAOA solution of the same instance: gamma = mean of the QAOA gammas, thetaK = thetaM = 0, shell row l = (beta_l, 0, 0), plus N(0, 0.15) and N(0, 0.40) perturbations of that vector. w1 equals sum X on a partition, so the unperturbed point is that projection. The fourth point uses the same shells and gamma, and sets thetaK and thetaM to the Pearson correlation of the classical diagonals dK and dM with Hc. No ground state, eigenvector, or fidelity enters the features, the starts, or the selection.
box: linear coefficients and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]

probe.purpose: development only, on instances already fit in round 4
probe.launch_confirmation_if: at least 4 of the 8 gate cells have new energy <= recomputed round-4 KM energy - 0.001. A baseline that disagrees with the stored energy by more than 1e-6 aborts the probe. Fidelity is not an input to this decision.

confirmation_if_launched.note: nodata and K are nested-seed providers only. KM's start list is the round-4 list plus the four extra starts at every L, built from that repeat's QAOA solution at the same L. One family, not a new gate.
per_N_all_required: Holm-adjusted one-sided sign-test p < 0.05 across the three N, ties excluded
95% bootstrap CI lower bound of median (F - F_QAOA) > 0
at L=5, median (F - F_QAOA) > 0 and wins >= losses
each repeat's own selection has median (F - F_QAOA) > 0
replay gate passes at that N
confirmation_if_launched.overall: confirmed if every N passes; partial if N=6 and at least one of N=9 or N=12 pass; not confirmed otherwise

selection: lowest energy. Primary is the lower of the repeats when a confirmation is run. The probe compares the best of the four new starts with the stored round-4 KM energy.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection
